text: Cossio Cares for Alpine’s Students. Teachers. Families.
Alpine is more than a place we call home, it’s a community that looks out for one another. I believe our schools should reflect that same spirit of community, pride, and commitment to one another.

As a candidate for Alpine School Board, I will champion strong instruction and a back-to-basics approach, ensuring every student builds a solid foundation in English, math, and science. I believe every child deserves a safe, respectful classroom where learning comes first, with zero tolerance for unacceptable behavior.

I also know that great schools start with great teachers. Recruiting, supporting, and retaining excellent educators will be a priority, because our students deserve the very best and our teachers deserve a school district that values their dedication and expertise.

For our students. For our teachers. For our families.
For the Alpine community we love.
I care about our students and believe Alpine’s future is worth caring about.

text:
Alpine has been our family home for 23 years. My wife and I have been married twenty five years, and our three children came up through Alpine Union schools and on to Granite Hills. This community shaped my family. I bring a perspective no other candidate offers. I am simultaneously a teacher at Granite Hills, a parent, and a sitting board member. I see what happens at the school level, what our students and families need, and how governance plays out in the boardroom and the classroom.
When I joined the board in 2014, I described public education’s pace as a “sloth eating molasses,” slow and resistant to change. Working with the superintendent and governance team for twelve years, I have helped replace it with accountability, preparation, and forward momentum. I have held every officer position on the board, President, Vice President, and Clerk, and completed the California School Boards Association Masters in Governance. I led the field in three consecutive elections. I believe in fiscal discipline, local control over mandates from Sacramento, and transparency for our students and our community.
I am asking Alpine voters to let me keep serving our students, our schools, and our community.

text: I have proudly called Alpine home for over 27 years. My son is a graduate of our local schools, and I want my grandchildren to inherit an even stronger district. Combining a background in finance and information technology with my experience on the school board, including serving as Board President, I bring the disciplined, transparent leadership needed to protect our schools.

During my tenure, we have delivered balanced budgets, maintained healthy reserves well above state-required minimums, and consistently achieved clean audits. We did this while prioritizing direct classroom investments and securing competitive grant funding to protect local taxpayer dollars.

We have built premier academic opportunities, including our nationally recognized coding and engineering program, a dual-language program, and a stable multi-year teacher contract. During challenging times, I guided our district to safely reopen classrooms, balancing public health requirements with the needs of our students.

My priorities remain clear: protect parental rights, maintain strict fiscal discipline, and ensure academic excellence. Endorsed by trusted community leaders and backed by years of steady service, I respectfully ask for your vote to keep Alpine Union School District the premier destination in East County.

text:
As a Governing Board Member of the Alpine Union School District, it has been my pleasure to serve the students, parents, and residents of Alpine for the past 20 years. We have accomplished so much together during my tenure including increasing test scores, balancing our budgets, improving school safety programs, a culture of ensuring parental rights are honored, and implementing a national award-winning engineering and robotics program. We have continued to reiterate the importance of a primary education in Alpine to ensure all students are prepared for high school and beyond. Alpine School District will continue to innovate while guiding all students to understand the importance of mathematics, language arts, and science. Together we can continue to grow our local st
education initiatives into the 21 century and I ask for your support and your vote.
